manufacturer_evidence.document: Renewing the software license, article ID 159899
excerpts: From Kaspersky Business Hub, you can renew licenses for Kaspersky Endpoint Security Cloud.

You can renew a license online if fewer than 30 days remain before the license expiration date and only if the license was purchased on the Kaspersky website. To renew other licenses, you must contact a partner company of Kaspersky.
You cannot renew a Kaspersky Endpoint Security Cloud license that was purchased before version 8.0 was released (that is, before April 2019).
